'''Stormtrooper The force is strong in this deck1.0''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Stormtrooper (GPN)|Stormtrooper]]
* '''Published:''' 6 September 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Home One: Docking Bay|DS2-L-homeonedockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Home One: Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Home One Docking Bay Stormtroope.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A lot of Jedi's and Force- Padawan Learner in this Deck (zB.:Qui-Gon, Obi-Wan Padawan Learner, Commander Luke Skywalker........).

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

First I draw the card ''Tatooine: City Outskirts''.Than I can search a Jedi from Reserve Deck.(This is my beginning Srategy)

My normaly Strategy is to destroy oppent's charakter with strong weapons(Lightsaber

Golan LAser Battery...)
